description: This record groups three Spanish regional open registers of energy performance certificates, the ratings every building must have when built, sold or let. Catalonia's ICAEN dataset has about 1.34 million certificates entered since September 2016, updated weekly, with 71 fields such as address, cadastral reference, climate zone, floor area, year of construction, building use, energy and emissions ratings, final energy use, estimated annual cost and whether an electric vehicle charger is present. Aragón publishes the certificates in the first section of its register by province in CSV, JSON, XLSX and XML, and Castilla-La Mancha publishes its register by province and year, with cadastral reference, for projects, new and existing buildings. Coverage: three Spanish regions. Access: free on the regional open data portals. Licence: Aragón CC BY 4.0; Castilla-La Mancha CC BY-SA; Catalonia under the portal's terms of use. Caveats: certificates cover only buildings that were sold, let or built, and ratings are calculated, not metered; schemas differ by region. Simulation uses are building stock energy and retrofit models joined by cadastral reference, and heat resilience screening of dwellings. Related records: the Lombardy CENED certificates, the England and Wales EPC register and the ADEME energy performance diagnostics.
